scope: Full finite-n lower bound and full sequence-wise upper limit for the actual attained finite edge entropy minimum. Also proves convergence of the normalized minimum for every sequence n_j tending to infinity and p_j in (0,1) tending to zero. Includes exact step formulas, clipping, finite attainment, balanced finite color copies for every n, diagonal deletion bounds, strict-slack competitors, uniform-in-p eventual feasibility and the vanishing sparse entropy correction.
